standard_prerequisites.name: A filtered union of finitely generated subalgebras of a ring of finite type over a Noetherian base is Noetherian
standard_prerequisites.use: Is the specific statement that replaces the general false statement about filtered colimits.

core_obligations: Relate the henselization of the pair to the strict henselization and to the base ring (proof lines 11002-11025).
Write the strict henselization as a filtered colimit of finite etale algebras, each of finite type over the base and hence Noetherian (proof lines 11025-11045).
Show that the henselization is a filtered union of finitely generated subalgebras of the strict henselization (proof lines 11045-11060).
Conclude that the henselization is Noetherian (proof lines 11060-11064).
proof_roadmap: Place the henselization between the base and the strict henselization (proof lines 11002-11025).
Use the finite etale presentation of the strict henselization (proof lines 11025-11045).
Write the henselization as a filtered union of finitely generated subalgebras and conclude (proof lines 11045-11064).
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the henselization of a pair over a Noetherian ring is again Noetherian, and the proof is a 63-line argument that relates the henselization to the strict henselization. It uses that the strict henselization is a filtered colimit of finite etale algebras over the base, each of finite type and hence Noetherian, and that the henselization is a filtered union of finitely generated subalgebras of the strict henselization. The two colimit descriptions and the passage between them are carried out in the source.
